name: water tank level controller
description: A tank is filled by a noisy inflow and drained by a constant demand and by a controlled valve (maximum 6 volume units per step). One step is one time unit; the tank starts half full. The controller either opens the valve in proportion to how far the level is above the setpoint (mode proportional, with the given gain) or fully opens it whenever the level is above the setpoint (mode bang_bang). If the level would exceed the capacity the excess spills and is added to the spilled total; the level never goes below zero.

parameters.name: inflow
parameters.text: mean inflow per step, with up to +/-20% noise

parameters.name: setpoint_fraction
parameters.text: target level as a fraction of capacity

rules.text: The water level is never negative.
The water level never exceeds the tank capacity.
The valve opening stays between 0 and 1.
